critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~740 lines; still acceptable but plan to split into routers (auth, orders, uploads, profile, analytics).

/api/files path validation is minimal (only prefix check); path traversal request with '..' currently returns 400 (via storage_get) — good, but consider explicit reject of '..' segments in the route for defense in depth.
DropZone hides the browser file input but the visible dropzone is a <div role='button'>; consider keyboard-triggered upload (Enter/Space) for a11y.
CardPreview relies on inline styles for perspective/gradients; consider extracting to a small CSS module if reused elsewhere.
